notify.fitted: Thruster kit fitted. Get in the driver's seat to use it.
notify.noVehicle: Stand next to a vehicle or sit in one.
notify.notAllowed: This vehicle can't take a thruster kit.
notify.already: This vehicle already has a thruster kit.
notify.notFitted: This vehicle has no thruster kit.
notify.inventory: Your inventory didn't answer. Nothing was fitted; try again.
notify.slowDown: Wait a moment and try again.
notify.unknown: No answer from the server. Check the vehicle before trying again.
notify.empty: Cold gas empty. The thrusters are off until the tank refills.
notify.trickWall: Hop off the wall before a trick.
hud.label: Cold gas
settings.legend.help: Show the thruster controls when you take the driver's seat of a fitted vehicle.
settings.hud.help: The cold gas gauge above the speedometer while you drive a fitted vehicle.
notify.hudUsage: Move the gauge: /thrusters hud <right> <bottom> (default 40 200), or /thrusters hud reset.
notify.gripCooling: Grip fans cooling. Ready in {seconds} s.
notify.moving: Stop the vehicle before fitting the kit.
settings.landing.help: After a jump the car levels itself and the lift nozzles soften the touchdown.
